usageSections.title: Installation
usageSections.description: Install the Mizen package and import the required parts. These examples use Mizen surfaces and Tabler icons.

usageSections.title: Single Selection
usageSections.description: Provide items and render each option through ComboboxList. The root supports controlled and uncontrolled selection.
usageSections.code:
const frameworks = ["React", "Vue", "Svelte"];

<Combobox items={frameworks}>
  <ComboboxInput aria-label="Framework" placeholder="Choose a framework…" />
  <ComboboxPopup>
    <ComboboxEmpty>No frameworks found.</ComboboxEmpty>
    <ComboboxList>
      {(framework: string) => (
        <ComboboxItem key={framework} value={framework}>{framework}</ComboboxItem>
      )}
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxPopup>
</Combobox>

usageSections.title: Multiple Selection
usageSections.description: Set multiple and render selected values as chips. Use ComboboxChipsInput for search and name each removal action.
usageSections.code:
<Combobox items={frameworks} multiple>
  <ComboboxChips>
    <ComboboxValue>
      {(values: string[]) => values.map(value => (
        <ComboboxChip key={value} removeProps={{ "aria-label": `Remove ${value}` }}>
          {value}
        </ComboboxChip>
      ))}
    </ComboboxValue>
    <ComboboxChipsInput aria-label="Frameworks" placeholder="Add framework…" />
  </ComboboxChips>
  <ComboboxPopup>
    <ComboboxEmpty>No frameworks found.</ComboboxEmpty>
    <ComboboxList>
      {(framework: string) => (
        <ComboboxItem key={framework} value={framework}>{framework}</ComboboxItem>
      )}
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxPopup>
</Combobox>

If the provider writes [1] markers, they become chips for those sources. Earlier replies in the thread are complete; only the latest one streams.
